title: Astre
description: Asteroids, back from 1979 — on a warm cream sky. An inertial rocket, rocks that split three ways, a field that wraps at every edge. Modern touches: a dash you can trust (with a heartbeat of immunity), combo chains up to ×8 with a slow-motion beat, hunting drones from wave 2 and a mega-rock to crack every fourth wave. Extra life every 10 000 points. Keyboard and touch, in English, French and Spanish.
controls: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD/ZQSD; Space fires; Shift dashes along your nose; P pauses.
On touch: a left stick steers the rocket (push far to thrust), FIRE and DASH buttons on the right.
The rocket keeps drifting — short bursts, calm hands. The sky wraps around at every edge.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
